system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Flesh Crafter

As Nature Energy accumulates in your body, it physically manifest by hardening your skin, extending your reach and radiating outward as an oppressive pressure that hostile creatures can feel just by being near you. You gain passive benefits based on your current Nature Energy level (This will be abbreviated to NE in the associated effects). This occurs automatically and doesn’t require any action on your part.

| Feral Abandon – Feral Mania / [Physical], [Mental] / A creature can only experience Feral Mania if they are of the Jugo Clan and have reached the maximum amount of Nature Energy, they can maintain. While experiencing Feral Mania, you gain the following penalty and benefits: / Penalty / Feral Frenzy. You do not distinguish between friend and foe. All creatures are treated as hostile to you. Each time you experience Feral Mania per combat, count the number of creatures in combat and in the immediate area within 60 feet of you. Assign each creature a number, starting from the closest creature being 1. If an Elite class adversary is present, they should be counted twice, given two different values. If a Solo class adversary is present, they count a number of times equal to the total number of player characters, minus 2 (min 1). At the start of each of your turns while in Feral Mania, roll a dice that is closest in size to the number of people counted (Ex. 7 Creatures, you roll a d8. 14 Creatures, roll a d20). All values that don’t associate with a counted creature forces you to reroll until you land on such a value. The creature landed on becomes your Frenzy Target for this turn. / Frenzy Target. You must spend your turn moving as close to the creature as possible while also attempting to inflict as much damage to them as possible. / Untamed Frenzy. Feral Suppression, and The Hunter features can no longer stop you from entering Feral Mania or select your Marked Prey. You can still use your expenditures targeting your Frenzy Target. / Benefits / A creature experiencing Feral Mania gains a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases to +2, if attacking a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A creature experiencing Feral Mania that scores a critical hit, adds 2d12 force damage to the result. This increases by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels. / A creature experiencing Feral Mania can make one additional weapon or Unarmed attack when they take the Attack Action. / A creature experiencing Feral Mania speed increases by +10 feet. They gain an additional +10 speed when moving towards a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A creature experiencing Feral Mania spends 4 feet of movement for every 1 feet they spend moving away from a valid hostile creature while not also moving towards another valid hostile creature. / A creature experiencing Feral Mania maintains this condition until their Frenzy Target is dead, or this condition is cleansed. / A Creature attempting to cleanse you of conditions does not need you to be willing. |

Nature Shell – 2+ NE: Your skin hardens and grays throughout. You gain bonus DR equal to half your level, minimum 1 while not wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.

Predator’s Grasp – 4+ NE: Your limbs elongate subtly. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property and adds +2 bonus to the damage dealt.

Natures Endurance – 6+ NE: Your body recycles Nature energy faster than ever making it exceedingly difficult to hold you down. You gain a rank of Mastery to two of the following Saving throws; Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, your choice when you first gain access to this bonus. You can change your selection when you complete a long rest.

Tyrants Presence – 8+ NE: Nature Energy radiates from your body like heat from an engine. Hostile creatures that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, must make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu Save DC losing their Reaction on a failure, until the beginning of their next turn.

King of Savagery – 10 NE: You grow in size by 1 size category and you regain Hit points equal to your level at the beginning of each of your turns.

If at any point during your turn, you have reached the maximum Nature Energy you can maintain, it overwhelms you causing you enter a state of Feral Mania. Features you have that reference Mania, also count for Feral Mania and

If you take this Trait, you must take Full Sage: Undiluted Rage Mutated feature.
